description: This Java source file defines the class `SimpleWikiHelper`, which provides helper methods for interacting with a lightweight Wiktionary API, including fetching page content and handling HTTP requests, along with associated exceptions.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to communicate with the Wiktionary API, manage user-agent string setup, and handle API responses and errors.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating problems with API communication.

classes.name: ParseException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating problems parsing API responses.

methods.name: prepareUserAgent
methods.description: Initializes the user-agent string using application package info.

methods.name: getPageContent
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specified Wiktionary page, with optional template expansion.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request for a given URL and returns the response content as a string.
